title: Nuecrete By Studio Bagno - The New Concrete Basin Range
bodyHtml:
We're welcoming the newest member to the Studio Bagno product range - Introducing NueCrete: The new concrete Above Counter Basin range!

NueCrete is moulded from fibre reinforced concrete, a revolutionary process that creates a sealed and non-porous finish, allowing you to introduce concrete to your next bathroom project for a truly contemporary style. Best of all, NueCrete is made by hand right here in Australia!

We've come up with 3 gorgeous contemporary above counter basin shapes, with each being available in 6 exciting, brand new colourways.

1. Tundra (Charcoal)

A soft internal edge, as if sculpted by the ocean, creates a welcoming bathroom vanity centrepiece. 

2. Silo (Charcoal)

The pure geometry of the circle. Forever contemporary, Silo has crisp, sharp walls which play with light.

3. Quarry (Charcoal)

Simple and purposeful, the rectangular shape of Quarry is the epitome of architectural minimalism.

Colourways

6 Modern New Colourways are available for NueCrete Concrete Basins:

001. Original Concrete
002. Storm Grey
003. Powder Blue
004. Rose Quartz Pink
005. Pumice White
006. Charcoal

Available Now!


As actual colours may differ, be sure to consult with us for a viewing. For more information about NueCrete call us on (02) 9601 1948
